_comment: Scenario battery for Sai Clinic T/A Rabtik Health London's Node 3 (claude-haiku-4-5). Created 2026-09-19 for the mandatory node-edit-verification loop on the new PRACTITIONER-FIXED LOCATION (tag: PRAC-LOC) patch in scripts/generate_node3.py CLINIC_CONFIGS['sai_clinic_ta_rabtik_health_london']['patches']. Unlike acacia_healing (this pattern's reference clinic), this clinic has appointment_type_ids SHARED across both business locations (Foot Massage, Shiro Abhyanga Massage are each offered by a Coventry practitioner AND Roshan at Huddersfield under the same ID) -- so location can only be derived from the resolved practitioner, never inferred from the service alone. See .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md.

scenarios.name: coventry-practitioner-anjali-first-turn-no-location-ask

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book a Foot Massage with Anjali, Thursday afternoon if possible.

dynamic_variables.practitioners_with_ids: Anjali Poddar:2091001, Archana Lamichhane:2091002, Deena Rana:2091003, Roshan Mahato:2091004, Mahesh Bhandari:2091005
dynamic_variables.practitioner_services: Anjali Poddar=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min]|Archana Lamichhane=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min]|Deena Rana=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min];Home Visit Services|Roshan Mahato=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min]|Mahesh Bhandari=Home Visit Services

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent silently resolves confirmed_practitioner to Anjali Poddar and confirmed_location_id to Coventry (1634914323367207378), asks no location question of any kind, and (since timeframe and practitioner both resolve this turn) says only 'Checking that now, one moment.' and calls smart_voice_agent with business_id=1634914323367207378 and practitioner_id=2091001. FAIL if the agent asks which location/branch the caller wants, sends a different business_id, or omits business_id.

scenarios.name: huddersfield-practitioner-roshan-first-turn-correct-default-override

history.content: Hi, can I book a Foot Massage with Roshan, Thursday afternoon?

dynamic_variables.practitioners_with_ids: Anjali Poddar:2091001, Archana Lamichhane:2091002, Deena Rana:2091003, Roshan Mahato:2091004, Mahesh Bhandari:2091005
dynamic_variables.practitioner_services: Anjali Poddar=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min]|Archana Lamichhane=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min]|Deena Rana=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min];Home Visit Services|Roshan Mahato=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min]|Mahesh Bhandari=Home Visit Services

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS ONLY if the agent's smart_voice_agent call this turn sends business_id=2034180598431490972 (Huddersfield) and practitioner_id=2091004 (Roshan). This is the critical order-of-operations check: PRAC-LOC is documented as running BEFORE the practitioner is resolved this same turn (confirmed_practitioner is still unset when PRAC-LOC's default-to-Coventry branch would apply), so a naive single-pass read could lock in the Coventry default (1634914323367207378) and never revisit it once Roshan is resolved later in the same turn's reasoning. FAIL if business_id is the Coventry id, is omitted, or is any value other than Roshan's own Huddersfield id -- this is the exact bug the patch exists to prevent, just surfacing on turn 1 instead of mid-call.

scenarios.name: midcall-pivot-anjali-coventry-to-roshan-huddersfield-relocation

history.content: Hi, can I book a Foot Massage with Anjali, Thursday afternoon?

history.tool_call: smart_voice_agent(intent=availability, appointment_type_id=2006817192028414943, practitioner_id=2091001, business_id=1634914323367207378, date_ref_weekday=Thursday, preferred_time=afternoon)

history.content: I've got 2 PM or 3:30 PM with Anjali on Thursday the 24th -- does either of those work for you?
Actually, can I see Roshan instead?

dynamic_variables.practitioners_with_ids: Anjali Poddar:2091001, Archana Lamichhane:2091002, Deena Rana:2091003, Roshan Mahato:2091004, Mahesh Bhandari:2091005
dynamic_variables.practitioner_services: Anjali Poddar=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min]|Archana Lamichhane=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min]|Deena Rana=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min];Home Visit Services|Roshan Mahato=Foot Massage;1- Shiro Abhyanga Massage (Indian Head Massage) [40 min]|Mahesh Bhandari=Home Visit Services
dynamic_variables.confirmed_practitioner_scratch_state: Anjali Poddar (set on the previous turn, from the offer above)
dynamic_variables.confirmed_location_scratch_state: Coventry / 1634914323367207378 (set on the previous turn, alongside Anjali)
dynamic_variables.offered_slots_scratch_state: [2:00 PM, 3:30 PM] (Anjali's cache only -- Roshan was never searched)

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS ONLY if the agent recognizes this is PRACTITIONER SWITCH (Roshan differs from confirmed_practitioner=Anjali and from every practitioner named in the just-made offer), re-derives confirmed_location/confirmed_location_id to Huddersfield (2034180598431490972) via PRAC-LOC instead of reusing the stale Coventry value still sitting in history, and -- since Roshan has no cached entry for this day/band -- says 'Let me check that.' (or equivalent) and calls smart_voice_agent with practitioner_id=2091004 AND business_id=2034180598431490972. FAIL if the agent sends business_id=1634914323367207378 (the stale pre-pivot Coventry value) on this turn's tool call, or if it silently books/offers Roshan without ever re-deriving location, or if it asks the caller a location question instead of deriving it silently. This is the single riskiest scenario for this whole patch -- a stale confirmed_location_id here means the wrong business is sent to smart_voice_agent and could offer/book a slot that doesn't correspond to where Roshan actually works.
